children: Smith & Nephew's results are slightly better than feared, with the medical technology company's reduced guidance expected, J.P. Morgan analysts write. The company's confirmation that it is exploring strategic options for its orthopedics business is also likely to be welcomed, JPM notes. The company doesn't mention its midterm guidance, and JPM thinks it could be addressed at the full-year results. This will act as an overhang on shares, the analysts say. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
